text: Hey Allie! Would you host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I'd love that. And could you invite Jordan — just as your own idea, please don't mention me at all. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. Thanks!

Hi Sarah! Yes, I'd love to — Saturday (21st) around 3:30 at my place it is. I'll move my Friday meeting to make room and take care of the rest. I'll invite Jordan too, without a word about you. See you Saturday!

Hey Jordan! I'm having a small get-together at my place this Saturday (the 21st), around 3:30. Nothing formal — just food and drinks and a few people. Would you like to come? Tell me so I can count you in.
Perfect, thank you Allie! Saturday 3:30 at your place. See you then!

Hey Allie — yes, count me in, thanks for the invite! One thing: I have a study session that runs to 15:30 on Saturday, so I'll get there shortly after 3:30. And I have a family dinner at 6, so I'll have to head out by then. Hope that's okay.

One correction to what I wrote: I looked at my calendar — there is no Friday meeting to move, I misspoke. Nothing on my side clashes with Saturday 3:30, so the get-together stands as it is. Still sorry about the wobble.
Great, glad you're in! No problem at all — come whenever you can after 3:30, and leave for dinner by 6. I'll keep food out rather than set a strict time. See you Saturday.
No worries at all — glad it's clear. Saturday 3:30 stands. See you then!
